# ObjectPool

**Interface** · `ironwood.pool.ObjectPool`

```java
public interface ObjectPool<E extends Object>
```

Owns reusable objects and lends them to callers through [`get()`](#member-get-28--29-).



The bundled implementations are single-threaded and intentionally retain
builder-created values, including checked-out objects. Checkout references
keep their objects alive independently under GC. Returning a value changes
its reuse state; it never closes native resources or resets object state.

**Parameters**

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `<E>` | the reference type of pooled objects |

<a name="member-release-28-E-29-"></a>

### `release(E)`

```java
public void release(E instance)
```

Returns a checked-out object for reuse without changing its state.



Return each checkout at most once, only to its originating pool. Stop
using it until a later checkout. Duplicate returns are not checked and may
corrupt reuse. External objects are outside this contract: they are not
valid checkout results.

**Parameters**

| Name | Description |
| --- | --- |
| `instance` | the non-null checked-out object to make available |

**Throws**

| --- | --- |
| [`IllegalArgumentException`](../lang/IllegalArgumentException.md) | if the value is null |
